# Pay Stub Printing Technical Notes

ClearPath Payroll provides local software tools for payroll calculation, reporting, and document preparation. It does not provide legal, tax, financial, accounting, or payroll compliance advice.

## Routes

- `/payroll/paystub/{payrollRunEmployeeId}`
- `/paystub/{payrollRunId}/{employeeId}`

## Service

`PayStubService` builds `PayStubModel` from `PayrollRunEmployee`, employee, company, earning line, deduction line, tax line, employer tax line, and net pay line data.

## Model Details

The model includes company and employee addresses, employee ID, SSN last 4, pay period, pay date, earning hours/rates, gross pay, employee taxes, employer taxes, pre-tax deductions, post-tax deductions, reimbursements, net pay, direct deposit last 4, check number placeholder, YTD placeholders, accrual placeholders, employer notes, and state-required-fields checklist placeholder text.

## Print Settings

`PayStubPrintSettings` controls local display options for hours, rates, YTD, employer taxes, employee address, accrual placeholders, and state-required-fields checklist placeholder.

## Security

No full SSNs, full bank account numbers, routing numbers, ACH files, or tax filings are generated by this feature.

## Distribution Caution

The page uses the neutral wording: “Review applicable pay statement requirements before distribution.”
